name: handy-processor
description: A tiny OpenAI-compatible post-processing server for Handy transcriptions

scripts.build: npm run build:correction && npm run build:ui && npm run build:server
scripts.build:sea:node26: npm run bundle:sea:node26 && npm run prepare:sea:node26 && node --build-sea sea-build/sea-config.node26.generated.json && node scripts/copy-sea-runtime-files.mjs
scripts.build:sea:node26:linux: npm run bundle:sea:node26 && npm run prepare:sea:node26:linux && node --build-sea sea-build/sea-config.node26.generated.json && node scripts/copy-sea-runtime-files.mjs
scripts.build:windows:portable: npm run build:correction && npm run build:sea:node26 && npm run stage:launcher:sidecar && npm --prefix launcher run build:portable && npm run package:windows:portable
scripts.build:linux:launcher: npm run build:sea:node26:linux && npm run stage:launcher:sidecar:linux && npm --prefix launcher run build:portable && npm run stage:launcher:config:linux
scripts.dev: npm run build:correction && npm run build:ui && tsx watch src/server.ts
scripts.test: npm run build && node --test dist/*.test.js && npm run test:packaging
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:server && npm run typecheck:ui
